parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the job template.

parameters.name: Suspend
parameters.description:
Start or suspend a job template.

*   true: Start a job template.
*   false: Suspend a job template.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sae suspend-job --app-id ee1a7a07-abcb-4652-a1d3-2d57f4150000 --suspend true --region cn-hangzhou
